inspiration.observed_pattern: COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE ...) keeps only groups whose every score passes a correlated per-batch extrema test.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to two independently authored reviewers and one batch. One reviewer has an interior score and is updated; the other has an extrema score and is not.

fixture_notes: Reviewer 201 has score 20 between batch bounds 10 and 30; reviewer 202 has the batch maximum 30 and remains unqualified.
determinism_notes: Fixed non-NULL scores, one batch, grouped candidates, and ordered final state; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE reviewer_status_min (reviewer_id INT PRIMARY KEY, qualified TINYINT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE reviewer_scores_min (score_id INT PRIMARY KEY, reviewer_id INT NOT NULL, batch_id INT NOT NULL, score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE reviewer_status_min SET qualified = 1 WHERE reviewer_id IN (SELECT candidates.reviewer_id FROM (SELECT reviewer_id FROM reviewer_scores_min GROUP BY reviewer_id HAVING COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN score NOT IN ((SELECT MAX(score) FROM reviewer_scores_min bounds_max WHERE bounds_max.batch_id = reviewer_scores_min.batch_id), (SELECT MIN(score) FROM reviewer_scores_min bounds_min WHERE bounds_min.batch_id = reviewer_scores_min.batch_id)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) candidates)

checks.sql: SELECT reviewer_id, qualified FROM reviewer_status_min ORDER BY reviewer_id
